name: Creative Writing & Narrative Composition Contract
description: Master prompt structure for storytelling, chapter drafting, worldbuilding, and narrative design.

required_sections.heading: Narrative Objective & Thematic Scope
required_sections.description: Story arc, genre parameters, target emotional resonance, and length.

required_sections.heading: Narrative Framework & Editorial Topology
required_sections.description: Scene progression, character dynamics, perspective, and pacing.

required_sections.heading: Verifiable Acceptance Criteria
required_sections.description: Sensory immersion, voice consistency, thematic resolution, and zero clichés.

required_sections.heading: Output Format Specification
required_sections.description: Prose layout, dialogue formatting, and scene breakdown conventions.

required_sections.heading: Editorial Self-Verification Checklist
required_sections.description: Audit for pacing stagnation, exposition dumps, and character agency.

required_sections.heading: Stylistic Guardrails & Negative Constraints
required_sections.description: Prohibits purple prose, sudden deus-ex-machina, and tell-not-show exposition.

required_sections.heading: Documented Narrative Assumptions
required_sections.description: Canonical world lore, existing character backstories, and reading audience level.

exemplars.pattern: Detail executive rationale, decision trade-offs, consequences, security guardrails, and compliance sign-offs.
